text: {"lessons":["I will judge each stock by its future prospects and role in my portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price; avoiding the discomfort of admitting a mistake can prolong a bad investment.","I will use consistent, forward-looking criteria for both selling winners and cutting or retaining losers, rather than taking profits quickly while letting losses ride.","A short run of gains or losses does not predict the next month. I will avoid reacting to noise and make deliberate choices that fit my overall risk and portfolio goals."]}
